'''June 2001 Fitchburg tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Fitchburg, MA on 3 June 2001. [[Eric Hunter]] won it. It is known from Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2457">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-14-ramapotatocon-triple-trd2457/ ramapotatocon-triple-tr], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 14 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-14-ramapotatocon-triple-trd2457/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Fitchburg, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Eric Hunter]]
